verdict.rationale: AngelList Stack Equity Management documents broad cap-table maintenance. It covers share class creation and editing, SAFE and note conversions recorded on the cap table, option grants that e-sign and auto-update the cap table, transfers that auto-generate share securities, and repurchases and terminations. It also offers stakeholder dashboards for investors, AI tie-out and health checks for accuracy, and auditor-relevant outputs such as ASC 718 reports and OCF/Excel exports. However, AngelList's own update FAQ describes helping customers transition to other cap table providers (J.P. Morgan, Pulley), which undercuts its role as an ongoing source of truth. Missing for 10: clarity that the equity product remains actively supported rather than being wound down, explicit certificate management, and independent or hands-on corroboration that investors and auditors rely on it.
